prompts.riftStaffPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE transparent pixel-art wooden magic staff for a fantasy tactics game, modeled after the attached weapon reference.
Draw one complete vertical staff, alone, straight-on side view, full top and bottom visible with generous transparent margin. Crooked slender wooden shaft, navy wrapped grip in the middle, a small curved dragon/serpent-shaped head forming an open oval around a floating-looking BLUE CRYSTAL that is physically supported by the wooden curls. The crystal sits inside the loop and stays connected, no detached sparkles. A thin subdued cyan vein follows a short stretch of wood near the lower shaft. Reproduce reference's overall crooked shape, loop, blue crystal, wrap and pointed wood foot, simplified to readable game pixel art.
Soft muted low-saturation colors, matte surfaces. LIMITED flat palette: #172638 navy outline/wrap; #77604f muted brown wood; #a394b1 muted warm edge; #77b8c7 soft cyan crystal/vein; #bbc1d6 very small pale crystal facets. Avoid shiny gold, white glare or many colors. Crisp clean pixels. Reference is shape guidance only, not photorealistic style. The sprite must remain readable when reduced to 65–120 pixels high. Single connected complete silhouette with slender handle and recognizable ornate loop. No text, scenery, hands, aura, glowing particles, extra weapons, shadow or base. Genuine transparent background.
prompts.riftMapsPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: six-pose MAP sprite sheet, EXACT 3 columns by 2 rows in the layout of image1.
Image1 is the edit target showing the same long-haired female mage in five directions/contexts. Image2 is the exact staff design to add.
Primary request: adapt ONLY the weapon-holding arm/hand and add the staff. Preserve the existing character's long solid navy hair, pale headband, face, sleeveless muted blue-purple split dress, mauve belt, natural skin, body proportions, and original leg/robe stances.
Pose layout: row1 col1 LEFT-facing IDLE; row1 col2 BACK walking; row1 col3 RIGHT-facing walking. Row2 col1 FRONT walking; row2 col2 LEFT-facing walking; row2 col3 repeat LEFT-facing idle.
Give every sprite ONE complete slender wooden magic staff matching image2: small crooked dragon/serpent loop enclosing a cyan crystal, dark wrapped grip, curved shaft. Staff is about the character's height, always held securely with fingers around its middle; no detached hand or staff. Use a single consistent anatomical LEFT holding hand: front-view staff on SCREEN RIGHT, back-view staff on SCREEN LEFT, right-profile staff in front on SCREEN RIGHT, left-profile and left-facing idle staff behind torso on SCREEN RIGHT. The OTHER arm keeps its original relaxed/casting position. Bend the holding elbow naturally around waist level. Staff stands almost vertical and stays clear of the face and hair; full loop and bottom visible. No raised attack gesture.
Body center, head/neck and waist remain at the SAME relative position as image1. Do not change body scale, legs, boots, skirt stance, face or hair, do not add armor or hat. This is a small arm/weapon edit, not a character redesign. Hair is a SINGLE flat navy color with NO highlight streaks. Clothes matte, existing pale trim is fabric, no shine. Muted low-saturation blue-purple body colors, subdued brown staff and soft cyan gem, minimal colors and clear dark outline.
Transparent background, equal roomy cells, full body and weapon, no labels, grid, floor/shadow, magic particles or effects. Clean readable pixel art.
prompts.riftBattlePrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: 3-frame battle-body sprite sheet, exactly THREE full-body sprites in ONE horizontal row.
Image1 is the EDIT TARGET; preserve its same female mage identity, long hair, blue-purple split dress, pale cloth trim, skin, stance and 3 original gestures. Image2 is the original low-resolution enemy pose reference for action intent. Image3 is the staff design.
ADD one matching crooked wood-and-cyan-crystal staff to her REAR hand on screen RIGHT. It has the dragon/serpent loop around a blue crystal and a dark wrapped grip. The same staff in all frames, same size/proportions, full loop and tip visible. Fingers securely wrap around the grip. The rear arm may close its hand and slightly bend its elbow to hold the new staff. The FRONT casting arm must retain the original gestures exactly:
LEFT sprite = source pose0: facing LEFT, resting stance, front casting arm down at her side, rear hand holding the staff upright beside body.
MIDDLE sprite = source pose1: facing LEFT, front casting arm raised ABOVE her head with open hand as in target; hair and skirt stream to the RIGHT; rear arm extends outward to the right and grips the staff at the original palm position. The staff follows that hand, it may lift/tilt slightly, but does NOT replace the overhead casting hand.
RIGHT sprite = source pose2: facing LEFT, front casting arm stretches horizontally FORWARD to screen LEFT, with the original hair streaming LEFT above it; rear elbow bends at her waist on screen RIGHT, hand holds staff upright. Do not hide the front hand or add extra arms.
Keep original pose order, torso lean, legs, waist, face size, standing height and hand intent. Exactly two arms and two legs, no duplicate limb. Head/face remain at the same height and cell coordinate in all three frames. Preserve full body, both hands, long hair, skirt, staff loop and shaft without clipping. Staff handle must remain visibly connected from loop to tip even when passing behind an arm.
Soft slightly muted enemy BLUE-PURPLE color scheme referencing swordmaster: #172638 outline and SINGLE-COLOR hair, #4f4f7d fabric, #bbc1d6 pale cloth, #dda77d skin, #373e64 shadow, #a394b1 mauve belt; subdued brown wood #77604f and soft cyan #77b8c7 crystal. Matte cloth and NO hair highlight streaks. Necessary contour and shadows retained. No shiny gold or saturated glow. No spell particles/effects, backgrounds, shadows, labels, grid or text. Genuine transparent background with ample cell margins. Crisp clean pixel art resolving at native 80x64 with fourfold detail.
prompts.riftFrontFixPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Correct ONLY the staff hand in this single front-facing female mage sprite. Move the entire staff and gripping hand from the viewer's LEFT to the viewer's RIGHT, held by the character's anatomical LEFT hand. The free right arm should hang naturally on the viewer's LEFT. Do NOT mirror the whole woman: keep her face looking FRONT, same hair/headband, same belt/sash direction, same split skirt, same stepping legs and boots. Only switch which arm holds the staff. Same crooked wooden staff with dragon/serpent loop, blue crystal and wrapped grip, same height. Fingers must close around the grip at waist level, elbow slightly bent. Complete staff shaft and bottom foot visible. Keep muted blue-purple matte clothing, pure dark navy hair and limited pixel-art colors. Transparent background. No shadow, glow, particles, text or extra limbs. Preserve character proportions and existing front-view pose.
